payload.name: Overconfidence bias
payload.fact: Financial literacy has a strong negative association with overconfidence bias in young Indian adults.

provenance.title: A Study on the Role of Financial Literacy in Mitigating Behavioral Biases
provenance.quote_or_locus: Results reveal a strong negative association between financial literacy and all five biases, with the most pronounced effect on overconfidence and present bias
